shorts_extract.hook: Harvard doctors handed hurting adults a bottle boldly labeled 'Placebo Pills' and told them zero medicine was inside — yet 59% still got real symptom relief.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Kaptchuk et al. (2010 PLoS ONE, N=80 IBS) + Carvalho et al. (2016 Pain, N=97 chronic low back pain) + Guevarra & Wager (2020 Nature Communications) EEG proof.
shorts_extract.twist: Why you don't need to be fooled: lifelong conditioned pill rituals fire prefrontal-to-brainstem opioid pathways that quiet your anterior cingulate pain alarm.
